MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show feels like a natural addition to my Fire TV setup because an Alexa display offers a useful new way to interact at home.",
    "The Blink bundle fits my previous Blink camera use and offers doorbell coverage, giving me a concrete reason to expand my home monitoring."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Memory cards relate to recording devices I have used, but that does not mean I need more storage now or know these cards will fit my devices.",
    "Earbuds, a portable speaker, and a USB hub serve needs I have not expressed through my recent home viewing and security purchases.",
    "The smaller Echo Show, Echo Dot, and WYZE camera interest me, but I would choose the Show 8 and expand Blink before buying overlapping devices or another camera system."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in home electronics seems to have been stretched into an interest in unrelated listening and computer accessories.",
    "Having recording equipment seems to have been treated as a reason to buy memory cards without evidence of a current storage need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Compatibility with the Fire TV and Blink devices I already use matters more to me than a broad resemblance to previous purchases.",
    "I need a clear added use, such as doorbell coverage or an Alexa screen; several devices serving similar purposes are alternatives for me, not things I would buy together."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my home viewing and monitoring interests but stretched them too far into general electronics and accessories without a clear current need."
}
